body:
Existing cards now show a compact relative schedule with expandable date/time controls. New cards keep these controls open during creation. A header menu changes section order within Content and Properties, preserves unfinished drafts, and remembers the order in the current browser. Motion respects the reduced-motion preference.

Verified the full local gate, affected release Chromium suites and targeted WebKit behavior. Rebuilt and restarted the existing manual application; HTTPS assets and all 29 pre-existing resource versions, pins, preferences and certificate are preserved. Broader existing WebKit dialog test limitations and physical-device coverage remain documented in progress/2026-09-30-card-usage-layout.md. No project scope, priority or acceptance status was changed.

metadata.summary: Compact card schedules and customizable section order verified
